controls.title: Technical documentation
controls.note: MATERIAL, PROPOSAL and ADR records carry the analysis, the decision and the dated evidence behind each change. This reports that such records exist and how many; whether they document the system adequately is the auditor's judgement.

controls.title: Automatic recording of events over the lifetime
controls.note: Every record is dated, so the ledger is an event log over the system's lifetime. A record without a creation date is one that cannot be placed in that timeline.

controls.title: Human oversight, documented
controls.note: Each RUN records the user's own authorising words verbatim. A run without one is a change nobody can show was authorised.

controls.title: Retention of automatically generated logs
controls.note: The ledger is append-oriented and nothing in this tool deletes a record. The retention window is reported beside this report rather than enforced: deciding what to keep is the operator's, not the tool's.
